text: Weapon recipe: white weapon + Rustic Sash + Whetstone → % phys
detail:
Vendor: normal weapon + Rustic Sash + Blacksmith's Whetstone → magic weapon with increased physical damage.
Magic sash → Heavy (40–49%), rare sash → Serrated (50–64%).
Casters: wand/sceptre/rune dagger/staff + Chain Belt + Whetstone → spell damage.

text: MS boots: boots + Quicksilver Flask + Augmentation
detail:
Vendor: boots + any Quicksilver Flask + Orb of Augmentation → movement speed.
Repeat with the result to raise it one tier per use (up to 30%).

text: Sapphire Ring usable (cold res): Iron Ring + Fireball
detail: Vendor: Iron Ring + Fireball → Sapphire Ring (+20–30% cold res, req. lvl 8).

text: Topaz Ring usable (light res): Iron Ring + Splitting Steel
detail: Vendor: Iron Ring + Splitting Steel → Topaz Ring (+20–30% lightning res, req. lvl 12).

text: Ruby Ring usable (fire res): Iron Ring + Heavy Strike
detail: Vendor: Iron Ring + Heavy Strike → Ruby Ring (+20–30% fire res, req. lvl 16).
Two-Stone Ring, req. lvl 20: two resistances at +12–16% each. Watch vendors and drops.

text: 4-socket items from ilvl 25 — check vendors every level-up
detail:
Item level 25+ can roll 4 sockets (chest, helm, gloves, boots, 2H).
Vendors restock on level-up: look for 4-links, or 4 sockets to fuse.
Item level 35+ can roll 5 sockets on body armour, two-handers and bows. Time to look for a 5-link.

text: Amethyst Ring usable · chaos res recipe
detail:
Amethyst Ring, req. lvl 38: +17–23% chaos res.
Vendor: ring/amulet + Amethyst Flask + Orb of Augmentation → chaos res.

text: Kitava: −30% all res — recap fire/cold/light to 75%
detail: Finishing Act 5 permanently lowers all resistances (incl. chaos) by 30%.
Item level 50+ can roll 6 sockets. Vendor a 6-socket item → 7 Jeweller's Orbs; a 6-link → 20 Fusings.

text: Kitava: another −30% all res (−60% total) — recap
detail: Finishing Act 10 lowers all resistances by a further 30% (total −60%).
